title: IRON MAIDEN
tickerText: ** RUN TO THE HILLS!! ** IRON MAIDEN ARE ONE OF THE MOST INFLUENTIAL AND ENDURING HEAVY METAL BANDS IN MUSIC HISTORY. FORMED IN EAST LONDON IN 1975 BY BASSIST STEVE HARRIS, THE BAND BECAME A DRIVING FORCE BEHIND THE NEW WAVE OF BRITISH HEAVY METAL, BUILDING A GLOBAL FOLLOWING THROUGH RELENTLESS TOURING, POWERFUL LIVE SHOWS AND AN UNMISTAKABLE SOUND. WITH CLASSIC ALBUMS INCLUDING THE NUMBER OF THE BEAST, PIECE OF MIND, POWERSLAVE, SOMEWHERE IN TIME AND SEVENTH SON OF A SEVENTH SON, MAIDEN CREATED AN EPIC STYLE BUILT AROUND GALLOPING BASS, TWIN-GUITAR MELODIES, HUGE CHORUSES AND BRUCE DICKINSON’S SOARING VOCALS. SONGS LIKE RUN TO THE HILLS, THE TROOPER, ACES HIGH AND FEAR OF THE DARK HAVE BECOME METAL ANTHEMS. THEIR ICONIC MASCOT EDDIE HAS APPEARED ACROSS ALBUM COVERS, STAGES AND MERCHANDISE FOR DECADES. AFTER MORE THAN 50 YEARS, IRON MAIDEN REMAIN A FORMIDABLE LIVE BAND, CONTINUING TO FILL ARENAS AND STADIUMS AROUND THE WORLD WHILE GENERATIONS OF FANS PROUDLY FLY THE FLAG FOR EDDIE AND THE BOYS.
